beats.prompt: Location: Old gayelle ground — East Trinidad. Island: Trinidad. Beat 1 action: The gayelle is not a ring. It is a memory. Cinematic lighting. Vertical 9:16 framing. No on-screen text.

Location: Old gayelle ground — East Trinidad. Island: Trinidad. Beat 2 action: Morning came soft over East Trinidad. The old fighting ground was empty. The dust still remembered last night's feet. Cinematic lighting. Vertical 9:16 framing. No on-screen text.
Location: Old gayelle ground — East Trinidad. Island: Trinidad. Beat 3 action: Kai Baptiste came back to give the stick away. Cinematic lighting. Vertical 9:16 framing. No on-screen text.

Location: Old gayelle ground — East Trinidad. Island: Trinidad. Beat 4 action: He found a doubles stall before he found his courage. Two orders. Bara warm, channa heavy. His hands would not stop shaking. Cinematic lighting. Vertical 9:16 framing. No on-screen text.

Location: Old gayelle ground — East Trinidad. Island: Trinidad. Beat 5 action: Nia Toussaint sat down beside him without a word. She did not look at Kai. She looked at the wood. Cinematic lighting. Vertical 9:16 framing. No on-screen text.

Location: Old gayelle ground — East Trinidad. Island: Trinidad. Beat 6 action: "Doh sing it unless yuh mean it," she said. Then softer: "But this stick already singing." Cinematic lighting. Vertical 9:16 framing. No on-screen text.

Location: Old gayelle ground — East Trinidad. Island: Trinidad. Beat 7 action: Kai tried to set the bois down on the ground. The bois would not stay. It came back to his hand like breath comes back to a chest. Cinematic lighting. Vertical 9:16 framing. No on-screen text.

Location: Old gayelle ground — East Trinidad. Island: Trinidad. Beat 8 action: Across the road, an old man watched. Cane in one hand. Eyes that had seen this stick before. Cinematic lighting. Vertical 9:16 framing. No on-screen text.
Location: Old gayelle ground — East Trinidad. Island: Trinidad. Beat 9 action: Papa Etienne Roach spoke seven words. Cinematic lighting. Vertical 9:16 framing. No on-screen text.

Location: Old gayelle ground — East Trinidad. Island: Trinidad. Beat 10 action: "That stick chose last time two hundred years ago." He turned. He walked away. Cinematic lighting. Vertical 9:16 framing. No on-screen text.
Location: Old gayelle ground — East Trinidad. Island: Trinidad. Beat 11 action: The bois pulsed once. The gayelle remembered. Cinematic lighting. Vertical 9:16 framing. No on-screen text.
